summary: Hexcel Corporation filed a Form 8-K on July 29, 2026, solely to report its Q2 2026 financial results and provide supplemental sales data by segment and market. The filing does not announce any special-situation transaction, strategic initiative, or governance event. It contains standard items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01 covering the earnings press release, Regulation FD disclosure, and exhibits. No deal terms, board actions, or extraordinary corporate developments are present. The filing is routine earnings reporting with no M&A, capital markets, or restructuring implications.
